name: Quake
what: The 1996 3D shooter that made online play and mods famous.

fanProjects.name: LibreQuake
fanProjects.what: Free levels, art and sounds for Quake engines, so you can play without the original files. Use it with a free engine like vkQuake.
howToPlay: Get a free engine like vkQuake or Ironwail and follow the README.

scopeNote: 3D shooters are epic. Start from the released code or a free engine instead of from zero.
